findings.passage: If you aren’t currently registered to vote, you can register on the same webpage under the “Register To Vote” box. You’ll need a valid driver’s license or state-issued ID card number and your current address.
findings.note: In her monthly newsletter she tells voters what is needed to register online: a driver's license or state ID number. She also tells voters to check their registration and lists who may vote, including being a U.S. citizen. No comment on photo ID at the polls or on new rules.
